title: Allowances
subtitle: Meal, transportation, housing and other allowances alongside your attendance - scoped to what you're authorized to see.
empty: No allowance entries for this period.

addEntry.title: Add an entry
addEntry.hint: Date, site, and clock-in/out are imported automatically - fill in the allowance amounts after adding.

detail.daySessionsLine: {{count}} sessions this day · {{hours}} h {{minutes}} min worked

fill.hint: One tap fills every day you worked in this period from your allowance prices - add only what has no price (travel, for example), then submit.

myPrices.title: My allowance prices
myPrices.hint: What each worked day is filled with, by site. A dash means you type it yourself.

prices.title: Allowance prices
prices.howItWorks: Each worked day fills itself from these prices. The site's price comes first, then the category's, then the person's own - the later wins. Leave a price blank to inherit it; an allowance priced at nothing is typed by the employee.
prices.sitesHint: The daily price of each allowance at each site, and the price of an overtime hour and an extra day.
prices.categoriesHint: Groups of staff with their own prices - engineers, technicians, workers... - for every site or for one site.
prices.noCategories: No categories yet. Example: "Technicians" get 200 expatriation at the Capital and 150 at the Factory.
prices.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete the category "{{name}}" and its prices? Its people go back to the site prices.
prices.peopleHint: Put each person in a category, or give someone their own prices.
prices.blankInherits: A blank price is taken from the level before (site, then category).
prices.invalidPrice: A price must be a number of zero or more.
prices.notAllowed: Only the Owner and those who approve allowances set prices.
